articles.title: BizClik Announces Watershed-Led AI & Sustainability Workshop at Net Zero Summit 2026
articles.mainIdea: BizClik Announces Watershed-Led AI & Sustainability Workshop at Net Zero Summit 2026
articles.summary: PR Newswire: BizClik Announces Watershed-Led AI & Sustainability Workshop at Net Zero Summit 2026. As artificial intelligence becomes an increasingly important tool in sustainability strategy, Watershed will lead a dedicated workshop at Sustainability LIVE: The Net Zero Summit 2026, focused on how organisations can apply AI responsibly and effectively to drive measurable sustainability outcomes.

articles.summary: PR Newswire: BizClik Announces KINTO-Led Net Zero Automotive Workshop at Net Zero Summit 2026. BizClik has announced that KINTO will lead a dedicated automotive workshop at Sustainability LIVE: The Net Zero Summit 2026, focusing on how the automotive sector can accelerate the transition to net zero amid rapid technological, regulatory and supply-chain change.
